overloads.semanticRole: The Get text resource command returns the text stored in the text (“TEXT”) resource whose ID is passed in resID .

constraints: If resFile is omitted, the first matching TEXT resource found in the resource files chain is returned; if passed, only that file is searched.
Returns empty text and sets the OK system variable to 0 if the resource is not found.
A TEXT resource is limited to 32,000 characters.
